INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_DIALOGUE.title: Play special card dialogue
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_DIALOGUE.hover.de: When disabled, dialogue bubbles triggered by Indomitable card presentations will not be shown.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SOUND_EFFECTS.hov: When disabled, custom voice lines and sounds triggered by Indomitable card presentations will be muted, but can still use the default animation sound.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-PLAY_SPECIAL_LINE_ONCE: Play each card's special line once per combat

When enabled, each card type's special dialogue and audio share one use per combat. After that use, playing the same card type again uses the default animation sound. The limit resets when you enter or leave combat, including after loading a save.
